name: Michael Goorevich Sound Design & Mix
name_he: מיכאל גורביץ' – עיצוב פסקול ומיקס לסרטים
description: Central Tel Aviv film-sound studio with a large hybrid mixing/editing stage built to theatrical Dolby specs (4 m screen, JBL cinema monitoring): original sound design for features and TV, 5.1/7.1 film mixing and production sound, drawing on a 25-year library of self-recorded effects; credits span documentaries, features, dramas, sports and wildlife.
